body.name: measure-valued semi-infinite-LP dual
body.construction: Define \(\mathcal D(w)=\sup\{\kappa_\delta\sum_{\mathsf Q\in\mathscr A(w)}\lambda_{\mathsf Q}(\mathcal S_{\mathsf Q}(w)):\lambda_{\mathsf Q}\ge0,\ \int_{\mathcal S_{\mathsf Q}(w)}k_{\mathsf Q,a}(s)\,d\lambda_{\mathsf Q}(s)\le1\ \text{for every }(\mathsf Q,a)\in\mathscr A(w)\times\mathcal A\}\).
